visual_action: The video is a slideshow. It begins with a still image of Arnold Schwarzenegger speaking at a podium with a sign that says "#FAIRMAPS". Text overlay reads: "Former Republican California Gov. Arnold Schwarzenegger endorses Harris". It then transitions to a screenshot of a post from the social media platform X (formerly Twitter) by Arnold Schwarzenegger, in which he explains his decision to vote for "Harris and Walz" and criticizes former President Trump. The last line of the post, "I think the only way to do that is with Harris and Walz," is highlighted in yellow.

on_screen_text.text: Former Republican California Gov. Arnold Schwarzenegger endorses Harris

We need to close the door on this chapter of American history, and I know that former President Trump won't do that. He will divide, he will insult, he will find new ways to be more un-American than he already has been, and we, the people, will get nothing but more anger.

That's enough reason for me to share my vote with all of you. I want to move forward as a country, and even though I have plenty of disagreements with their platform, I think the only way to do that is with Harris and Walz.

spoken_summary: The video opens with Arnold Schwarzenegger's iconic movie line, "I'll be back," followed by an intense, electronic music track.
audio_music: The video starts with a famous audio clip from a movie, which is immediately followed by an intense, bass-heavy, and serious-toned electronic track ("wake up! (slowed reverb)") that plays for the remainder of the clip.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow consisting of two static images with text overlays.
cultural_references: Arnold Schwarzenegger as a film actor
The movie The Terminator, via the famous quote "I'll be back."
central_claim: Arnold Schwarzenegger, a famous actor and former Republican governor, has endorsed the Democratic ticket of Harris and Walz, framing it as a necessary step to move the country past the division caused by Donald Trump.
intended_effect: To persuade moderate, independent, or anti-Trump Republican voters to support the Democratic ticket by showcasing a high-profile endorsement from a well-known figure from outside the Democratic party.
